description.value: Wild Renfrew is a resort complex on the southwest tip of Vancouver Island offering waterfront cottages, forest domes, and a renovated 20-suite lodge — all positioned as a basecamp for the West Coast Trail and Juan de Fuca Marine Trail. The property includes an on-site pub and saunas, making it one of the more complete hospitality options in this remote stretch of coast. Accommodation ranges from dog-friendly beachfront cottages with fire pits to geodesic domes with private hot tubs.
